finding.summary: STORE.touch(mode=0o600) only sets permissions when the file is created and is subject to umask; if the token file already exists with more permissive permissions, they are never tightened, leaving OAuth tokens potentially world-readable.
finding.fix: After writing the file, explicitly call os.chmod(STORE, 0o600) to enforce the intended permissions regardless of prior state or umask.

label: false_positive
label_reason: Raised in review and merged with the file unchanged.
